title: Bring your own model
summary: Translations start with the built-in CC-CEDICT / HanDeDict dictionary, no key needed. Add your favourite LLM or DeepL on top to find translations for new words, stories for the hanzi movie method, or example sentences for daily life that use only words you already know.
imageAlt: Bring your own API Keys to benefit of LLM or DeepL
The LLM writes example sentences from words you already know. Select the good sentences and add them with a tag.
